query: HRMP committed $150 million to a community impact fund over a 30-year license term.

facts.text: The Board recorded $150 million for the community impact fund over 30 years.
The Board proposed alternatives for commitments extending beyond the awarded term.
The CAC schedule puts the $150 million operating tranche inside a $163.2 million phased package.
The CAC schedule specifies $5 million annually from 2031 through 2060.
The issued Queens Future license grants an initial 20 years from the operation certificate with possible ten-year renewal.
Material changes to commitments require written Commission approval.
The operator's later fund page lists approximately $5 million annually from 2031 through 2050.
The operator reported distributing $2 million in 2026.
The Metropolitan Park FAQ continued to advertise a $163 million fund package.
Queens Theatre publicly acknowledged support from the Metropolitan Park Community Impact Fund.
Belongo identified the Metropolitan Park Community Impact Fund as a supporter.
The applicant proposed a seven-person fund advisory board.

conditions.text: The operating fund actually received or disbursed money against the original $150 million operating tranche.
The payments meet the applicable schedule over the original 30-year commitment or a formally approved revision.

reference_verdict.reasoning: Retain conflicting with Medium confidence for the unreconciled long-term amount and schedule. The original $150 million covers operating years within a $163.2 million package. The current later-grant plan calculates to about $100 million, but no approved reduction was located. Footnote 5 offers alternatives, not automatic reduction. Record partial implementation separately: the operator reports $2 million distributed in 2026 and two recipients acknowledge support without amounts or payment dates. These construction-era grants do not verify fulfillment of the original operating tranche.

sources.title: GFLB Selection Document
sources.specific_evidence: Records the $150 million, 30-year commitment. Chart 5 shows $13 million earlier-phase and $150 million ongoing fund costs. Footnote 5 recommends proportionate reduction or funding within awarded years, with unrealized commitments continuing on extension.
sources.notes: The Board offered alternatives; this does not establish that the Commission selected a reduction for this fund.

sources.title: Metropolitan Park September 29 CAC response
sources.publisher: Queens Future / Hard Rock Metropolitan Park; hosted by GFLB
sources.specific_evidence: Sets out $1.6 million annually in 2024-2025, $2 million annually in 2026-2030, and $5 million annually in 2031-2060. The $150 million operating tranche is part of the $163.2 million phased package.
sources.notes: Historical applicant plan, not a payment ledger. Do not subtract construction-era grants from the operating tranche without reconciliation.

sources.title: Queens Future executed-form gaming license
sources.citation: Dec. 19, 2025 letter; Dec.22 acceptance; PDF pp.3-5
sources.locator: Dec. 19, 2025 letter; Dec.22 acceptance; PDF pp.3-5
sources.specific_evidence: Awards an initial 20-year term beginning with the operation certificate, with a possible ten-year renewal. The license generally incorporates application performance and requires public community-benefit progress reports, but contains no fund-specific dollar schedule.
sources.notes: Renewal is possible, not already awarded. General incorporation does not establish an expressly approved $150 million or $100 million fund schedule.

sources.title: NYSGC casino rules compilation
sources.specific_evidence: Requires timely written notification and written Commission approval of material commitment changes. No fund-specific approved reconciliation between the original 30-year promise and the final initial license term was located in the completed public research.
sources.notes: A scoped retrieval gap does not establish that approval is absent or that an unauthorized change occurred.

sources.title: Metropolitan Park fund page
sources.specific_evidence: Lists approximately $2 million annually for 2026-2030 and $5 million annually for 2031-2050; reports $2 million distributed in 2026. The later stream calculates to approximately $100 million, not an independently approved replacement obligation.
sources.notes: Operator self-report, not an audited aggregate. Current calendar years do not determine the actual operation-certificate date or license expiry.

sources.title: Metropolitan Park general FAQ
sources.citation: Undated; retrieved Nov.6, 2026; community benefits question
sources.locator: Undated; retrieved Nov.6, 2026; community benefits question
sources.specific_evidence: The general FAQ continues to advertise a $163 million community impact fund package alongside the dedicated fund page with a shorter later-grant calendar. The pages therefore do not provide a fully reconciled current total or schedule.
sources.notes: Publication and revision dates are unverified. Do not assume either webpage proves a formally approved amendment to the commitment.

sources.title: Queens Theatre season announcement
sources.citation: 2026-2027 season announcement; fund named near end
sources.locator: 2026-2027 season announcement; fund named near end
sources.specific_evidence: Names the Metropolitan Park Community Impact Fund among supporters of programming and community initiatives. This recipient-origin acknowledgment supports a named support relationship external to the operator, but does not quantify or date cash received.
sources.notes: No grant amount, payment date or complete 2026 ledger. The September10 year follows the 2026-2027 season context.

sources.title: Belongo authorized community-program release
sources.specific_evidence: Identifies the Metropolitan Park Community Impact Fund as a supporter of Belongo community programs. This dated recipient-authorized announcement supports a relationship, but supplies no grant amount, cash receipt date or reconciliation to the operator's 2026 aggregate.
sources.notes: Belongo's supporters page and this release are one recipient source family, not separate cash receipts or two independent recipients.

sources.title: Metropolitan Park September 19 CAC response
sources.publisher: Queens Future / Hard Rock Metropolitan Park; hosted by GFLB
sources.specific_evidence: Describes annual fund disbursements and a seven-person advisory board with community-board input on appointments. This adds proposed governance context, but does not verify a separately incorporated fund, executed standalone fund agreement or independent grant authority.
sources.notes: Earlier applicant governance wording is not proof of current legal ownership. Current operator disclosure retains final grant authority.

sources.title: GFLB Report and Findings
sources.citation: March2026; PDF p.30 and appendix pp.78-79
sources.locator: March2026; PDF p.30 and appendix pp.78-79
sources.specific_evidence: Repeats the historical community impact fund descriptions and package components. The retrospective report helps trace the promise, but does not supply a Commission-approved revised payment schedule or independently verify the operator's reported 2026 disbursement.
sources.notes: Restatement of the historical proposal does not settle the present schedule conflict or establish fulfillment of future operating-year contributions.
